seed_riff.reasoning: The riff anchors the 16 matras of Teentaal in heavy doom fashion: a ringing Sa power root on sam, palm-muted chugs, shifting to vadi Ma on beat 5, dipping through komal ga, and driving a characteristic Bageshree descending turnaround (D - m - g - R - S) into the next sam.

phrase_plan.climax_and_sam: peaks briefly at komal ni before settling on vadi Ma, cadence drives through ga-Re-Sa to re-enter sam on Ma

seed_head.idea: A dark, weighty Bageshree gat head landing on vadi Ma, alternating between the D-m anchor and the descending cadence

energy_arc:
Intro: Somber, spacious alaap establishing midnight darkness over the Sa-Pa drone.
Mukhada: Heavy half-time doom groove enters; sitar introduces the theme on vadi Ma.
Manjha: Tension simmers as melody descends into the deep mandra register.
Mukhada: Full band re-locks into the primary theme with crushing rhythmic weight.
Antara: Dynamic lift as sitar soars into the taar octave over churning rhythm.
Taan Long: Peak intensity driven by virtuosic chaugun runs over pounding drums.
Outro: Final monumental unison cadence slamming shut on the sam.

rhythm_section.reasoning: Arrangement for Bageshree Doom Fusion at 120 bpm in Teental (16 beats per avartan). Sitar leads over an ambient drone in Section 0 (no rhythm section). In Section 1 (Mukhada), guitar and bass establish the recurring doom groove across 16 beats: S power chord holds for 8 beats (broken into sustained ring, 8th-note palm-muted chugs, and spaces) followed by m power chord for 8 beats with a 16th-note turnaround back to Sam (2 + 0.5 + 0.5 + 1 + 1 + 1 + 1 + 1 = 8 beats on S, then 2 + 0.5 + 0.5 + 1 + 1 + 1 + 1 + 1 = 8 beats on m = 16 beats total). Section 2 (Manjha) moves to the mandra octave over a deep S pedal, answering sitar's rest at beats 12-16 with a crushing descending doom fill. Section 3 returns to the Mukhada theme using same_as: 1. Section 4 (Antara) climbs an octave (+1) moving through m and D power chords over 16 beats. Section 5 (Taan Long) anchors furious chaugun runs with a full 16-beat driving doom pedal on S (4 vibhags of 4 beats each). Section 6 (Outro) matches the sitar's unison cadence/tihai rhythm and rings out on the final Sa.
